_comment: AVAM occupation code -> PivotHop occupation slug. AVAM is SECO's official occupation nomenclature; every Job-Room ad carries exactly one code (measured 2026-08-04: 31,096 of 31,096). Codes were mapped from corpus evidence — the dominant German titles behind each code (scratchpad avam-report) — and only where the target occupation already exists in occupations.json. A code whose profession we do not carry stays OUT of this file and the posting stays unmapped: an honest miss beats a confident mis-map (the dental-hygienist rule). The _gaps section lists the biggest of those, with posting counts, as the shopping list for future taxonomy additions.

_gaps._comment: Big AVAM codes we deliberately do NOT map because the occupation is missing from the taxonomy. Counts from 2026-08-04. These are the Swiss market telling us what to add.
